island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a round wooden table covered in green felt with a fanned-out hand of oversized playing cards showing only big red heart and black spade suit symbols (no numbers or letters) and a small face-down stack of cards, a red paper lantern on a pole. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.
